3824.99 / 3826.00 (enzyme blends/preparations for industrial use — possible alternative classification)
product_summary: Website (infinitabiotech.com, homepage + /about/) describes the company as a Vadodara, Gujarat based 'multidivisional biotechnology company' and 'industrial enzyme manufacturer' producing eco-friendly enzymatic solutions in powder and liquid form. Named product lines: detergent enzymes; food enzymes (sugar, starch, malt extraction, bakery, dairy, meat); beverage enzymes (distillery, brewery, wine, juice extraction); textile enzymes; cosmetics enzymes; wastewater treatment enzymes; enzymes for hydrolysis of gel used in crude oil extraction; enzymes for crude oil spill remediation; soil stabilization enzymes; animal feed enzymes; agriculture enzymes; pulp & paper enzymes; disinfectants; enzymes for 2nd-generation biofuel (biodiesel, cellulosic ethanol booster); sea water remediation; pharmaceutical enzymes; ceramic industry enzymes. DSIR-recognised (per own about page). No individual SKU/grade list or technical datasheets were retrievable — product sub-pages returned HTTP 404.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-described manufacturer with own powder/liquid plants, testing labs and R&D; also states 'manufacturing, marketing and creating customized enzyme formulations', so a manufacturer_trader element is possible but not evidenced)
comment: HS 3507.90 is CORROBORATED by the product range: the entire catalogue is industrial enzymes/enzyme preparations, which is exactly heading 3507 (enzymes; prepared enzymes not elsewhere specified). Match = partial only because (a) 3507.90 is the correct residual subheading for most lines but the declaration does not distinguish 3507.10 (rennet/chymosin — plausible for the dairy/cheese line) and (b) several lines (detergent enzyme granules, textile and wastewater preparations, enzyme blends) may in practice be declared as 3824.99/3826.00 prepared enzyme blends rather than 3507 — cannot be verified without customs lines. HS 3002.49 (other pharmaceutical goods / blood fractions etc.) is NOT corroborated: the site has a 'Pharmaceutical Enzymes' application page, but nothing on the public pages shows a pharma-grade API, formulation, dosage form, sterile or pharmacopoeial product, or any drug licence claim. The 3002.49 line is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and looks like an over-declaration driven by the word 'pharma' in an application category. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a biotechnology/enzyme manufacturer; the oil & gas link is only an application niche (EOR gel hydrolysis, oil-spill remediation, biodiesel/cellulosic ethanol enzymes), not its industry. Correct industry = chemicals/biotech (industrial enzymes). Trader signs: none found — the site presents own manufacturing facilities, R&D and DSIR recognition; no evidence of pure resale. Product lines missing from the declaration: disinfectants (would fall under 3808.94 if sold as disinfectants, not 3507), and the biofuel/soil-stabilization/ceramic enzyme preparations. Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancy is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to 3507.90 as the primary line, with 3002.49 flagged as unconfirmed. No customs/B-L records were checked in this role (out of scope), so no shipment corroboration is asserted here.
